job: Find a report, paper, guide, webinar or template in a library filtered by kind and topic.
purpose: The resources library of Ember's site: a short head, the featured report with its cover set large beside its finding, then 30 resources as a grid of typographic covers (kind and title in type on the texture or the inverse ground, no images) with kind chips, a topic select, search, a live count, numbered pages and the filters in the address, and an empty state. The footer carries the newsletter sign-up column.
useWhen: Readers look for one kind or topic and share the filtered view.

avoidWhen.when: Posts read on the page, newest first.

sections.why: A short type-led head for a page that is mostly a library.
The featured report: its drawn cover set large beside what it found and its two actions.
The library: covers, kind and format lines, the tools bar with a live count, numbered pages and the empty state.
The library has no band of its own; the newsletter waits in the footer.

states.name: filtered
states.how: ?kind=report&topic=pricing&q=… or the tools; the count says "5 of 30 resources"

states.name: loading
states.how: ?state=loading: six skeleton entries, the tools off

states.name: empty
states.how: ?state=empty: nothing published yet, with the newsletter

states.name: no results
states.how: ?state=no-results: webinars about latency, none; fd-empty with Clear filters

states.name: error
states.how: ?state=error: fd-empty with Retry and the latest report

states.name: sign-up invalid, busy, sent, subscribed
states.how: submit the footer form: data-state invalid, then busy, then sent (dana@quarry.dev: subscribed)

states.name: menu open
states.how: below 900px wide, the header's menu button opens the links as a sheet (data-state="open")
